# Generated REST reference 🟡 BETA

Every route this server can mount, derived from the code. Prose belongs
in the hand-written pages of this chapter; this directory is a table.

## Regenerate

```bash
python3 scripts/gen_api_reference.py           # rewrite the pages
python3 scripts/gen_api_reference.py --check   # fail when stale
```

The generator reads `botserver/src/core/bot/endpoint_inventory*.rs` and
`botserver/src/core/bot/api_catalog/*.rs` (the intentional catalog) and the
`.route("...")` literals under `botserver/src/main_module/routes/` and
`botserver/crates/*/src/`. Path parameters are normalized to `:param`
before the two sources are merged.

## What the columns mean

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Method | HTTP verb taken from the method router (`get(`, `post(`, …) |
| Path | normalized route, `:param` for any parameter |
| Summary | catalog summary, or `schema not modeled` when there is none |
| Inventory | `yes` when the API command catalog also lists the route |
| Registered in | the file that mounts the route |

`schema not modeled` is literal: the handler has no typed schema, so no
request/response fields are invented here.
